description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for progress display functionality, including different scenarios such as regular progress updates, progress with throughput, long lines, break conditions, and trace generation. It uses a testing library and a command-line tool called 'test-tool' to run assertions on the progress behavior.

methods.name: show_cr
methods.description: Converts carriage return characters in stderr output to a representation using <CR> and line feeds.
